notes.title: Hailing from the Abyss Full Release with Steam Rhythm Fest! 35% OFF!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're very excited to announce that [b]Hailing from the Abyss 1.0 is now available with the start of Steam Rhythm Fest![/b] Along with the full release, comes a number of improvements, fixes, and additions, as well as a 35% discount!

The launch discount will be live for 2 weeks from August 19 to September 2. Don't miss out on the launch discount!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1797480/Hailing_from_the_Abyss/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget


[b][h1]Hailing from the Abyss 1.0[/h1][/b]

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] After clearing Stage 4-2, the game no longer stalls on a black screen. Players can now smoothly proceed to the result window without interruption.
[*] Corrected the names of Ending Cutscenes for improved clarity.
[*] Addressed an issue where selecting "Keep Playing" with the Enter key at interactive locations would inadvertently overlap with the interaction key, leading to unintended transitions to the difficulty selection screen. Added a buffer to prevent additional Enter key recognition when closing the options menu.
[*] Implemented a White Effect Disable Option along with a reduction in white effects for a more balanced visual experience.
[*] Introduced a Kill Effect Disable Option for players who prefer a cleaner interface.
[*] Re-added the calibration feature for enhanced gameplay precision.
[*] Resolved the issue where tutorial achievements were not displaying properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where dying after re-enabling game over was not functioning correctly.
[*] Fixed the Enable and Disable options for game over in the settings menu (they were previously switched).
[*] Fixed the dark screen issue after level 4-2.
[*] Fixed the pause menu popping up after pressing ESC to close the leaderboard.
[*] Fixed being unable to use the mouse wheel on the leaderboard.
[/list]


[b][h2]Improvements and Additions[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the “late” state to “normal” and changed the minus values since it was not fair. 
[*] Text color and size for "Perfect" and "Late" have been changed.
[*] Combo hit/miss text animation resized to be smaller and the animations have been adjusted.
[*] Kill text animation on the board has been relocated to avoid clashing with the arrows.
[*] Numpad Enter can now be used to skip story cutscenes.
[*] All cutscenes are now skippable.
[*] Added resolution change to the settings.
[*] Added sound option through pressing F2 and F3.
[*] Added a short extra scene to the game at the end of the game.
[/list]


[b][h2]New Achievements[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]To the Moon:[/b] Reach a score of 10,000,000 on any song.
[*] [b]Punishment:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 1.
[*] [b]Wasted:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 2.
[*] [b]Silenced:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 3.
[*] [b]Walking memories:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 4.
[*] [b]Assassinated:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 5.
[*] [b]Executed:[/b] Experience death in Chapter 6.
[*] [b]Grand Cheat Auto:[/b] Caught cheating by using the autoplay function.
[*] [b]Thank you!:[/b] Join the Discord server community.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41390870/fec3e584ad8fdad07131c21d83e1d15e7c8b3530.png[/img]

[b][h3]We hope you enjoy the full release of Hailing from the Abyss![/h3][/b]
